title: nrf_fuel_gauge mid-level helpers + standard memcpy/memset: function-level Renode M55 verified
approach: Bottom-up batch 2. Idiomatic scalar-float C; fg_memcpy/fg_memset call standard memcpy/memset (not typographic IAR). Function-level compare vs typographic stock on Renode 1.17 Cortex-M55. No fg_call trampoline.

harness.platform: Renode 1.17.0+20261102gite8c7c2d28, cortex-m55, FpuEnabled, CPACR 0x00F00000, SP 0x2007FB00, RESULT 0x20068000, halt 0x30000000
harness.mismatch_note: The remaining 1 mismatch is typographic-only fg_43a5dc (NaN payload 0x7FC00001 vs 0x7FC00000 on a canonical-qNaN t that 43a0f4 does not treat as special). 43a5dc was NOT replaced.

verified.notes: Wraps standard memcpy. Compared to typographic IAR forward-copy (fg_439be4) on sizes 0..200 and src/dst alignments 0..7. Return value is dst. No overlap path in stock IAR either.
Wraps standard memset. Compared to typographic wrapper+inner on sizes 0..200, alignments 0..7, fills 0/1/0x5A/0xFF/0x100/-1.
IAR error helper: stores 0x21 to fg_iar_err[0].
vsqrt of nonnegative s0; if s0 < 0, fg_439ca4 and return qNaN 0x7FFFFFFF. Bit-exact vs typographic including signed zero, inf, NaN, and the error side effect.
Max of a 3-float window, skipping a leading 43a0f4 hit. VSELGT (unordered keeps the running max).
Min of a 3-float window, same predicate skip. IT MI only on a strict less-than.
Scan 3 bytes, write 1-based indices of nonzeros, return count 0..3.
fabs of 2*count floats; out[0]=count, out[1]=2. Sign bit cleared, including NaN and -0.
fabs of p[1] floats; out[0]=1, out[1]=p[1].
Integer-ABI predicate on two doubles (wrapper around typographic 43c0b0 + sbcs/negs = !C).

not_replaced.notes: Quadratic interpolation is otherwise ready, but one canonical-qNaN t (43a0f4 returns 0) produced VFP NaN payload 0x7FC00001 vs C 0x7FC00000. Left typographic.
